text:
People Ops: FYI we just published a short policy update on evidence retention windows and a matching 72-hour sweep to bring artifacts into compliance. Deadline: 72 hours from this message (check local timezone). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

People Ops: What to do (quick):
- Complete the 8-min "Evidence Retention & Naming" micro-training (link below)
- Verify any control artifacts you own meet the new retention tag (retain_for_days) and naming pattern
- If you can't meet it yet, upload a placeholder and mark BLOCKED with owner + ETA
Links: training: https://internal.redwood/training/evidence-retention-2026  policy doc: https://drive.redwood.com/policies/evidence-retention  upload: https://internal.redwood/forms/evidence-upload

Elena R.: Do we need to re-upload old artifacts to new names or can we add metadata tags? We have a few large archives on S3.

Security Ops: If the object supports metadata tagging (S3), add the header x-amz-meta-retain_for_days and update the manifest. If not, re-upload with the new filename convention: redwood_evidence_YYYYMMDD_<control>_vX.zip. We prefer tagging to avoid duplication.

CTO Sam: Quick governance note - this change aligns with our SOC2 cadence and helps automation reconcile retention automatically. Please prioritize controls related to auth, audit, and incident response.

Priya (Legal): Managers: confirm by marking "legal-reviewed" in the upload form after your team updates artifacts. Legal will sample 10% of items post-sweep for verification.

People Ops: Office hours for migration help: Tomorrow 11:00-13:00 PT, drop into #help or book a 15-min slot with People Ops. If you're a manager, please push verification before the 72-hour window closes so Legal gets time to sample.

Elena R.: Noted. I'll try tagging existing exports. If we hit a storage quota, will that be a blocker?

Security Ops: If tagging isn't possible and re-uploads cause quota pressure, mark the item BLOCKED and include the storage team owner + ETA. We'll triage quotas first.

compliance-bot: Scheduled reminders: 48h and 12h before sweep close. Items still untagged will show as "non-compliant" in the compliance dashboard.

CTO Sam: For folks on infra-heavy teams: focus on controls CC-2, CC-5, and CC-9 first. Those have the highest impact for continuous monitoring.

Elena R.: Uploaded three items with updated metadata and left manifest links in the form. Two remain blocked due to vendor export timing (ticket #5543).

Priya (Legal): Thanks Elena. Mark the vendor-blocked ones with BLOCKED and we'll include them in the exception log, but please provide the vendor ETA so we can track.

People Ops: One last reminder: managers, after your teams finish, run the manager verification step in the form. We'll publish a brief sweep report and any exec risk notes after Legal sampling completes. Ping this thread if you need a hand. :white_check_mark:
